scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run build && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.build: bun run --filter @brickkit/core build && bun run --filter @brickkit/cli build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @brickkit/core typecheck && bun run --filter @brickkit/cli typecheck && bun run bench:typecheck
scripts.pages:dev: bun run build && bun run --cwd examples/pages dev
scripts.pages:test: bun run build && bun run --cwd examples/pages test
scripts.pages:typecheck: bun run build && bun run --cwd examples/pages typecheck
scripts.pages:build: bun run build && bun run --cwd examples/pages build
